description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: retrieve relevant passages, put them in context, generate a grounded answer with citations.
Load, clean, chunk, attach metadata, embed and index documents, and keep the index in sync with updates and deletions.
The component that turns a query into a ranked list of passages: keyword (BM25), vector, or hybrid.
Answering only from provided sources, with citations that can be validated.
Queries with known relevant passages, used to measure retrieval with recall@k, MRR and nDCG.
Never retrieving what the user cannot see: tenant and ACL filters applied inside the search.
